resolution.query_shape: symbol-name search within the control-plane provisioning/validation modules for the behavior under test

redaction_policy: Strip file paths, symbol names, line numbers, and any endpoint, subscription, or effective-config value before a resolved value leaves eval-runs.

resolution.query_shape: named-behavior lookup in the control-plane unit-test suite that asserts the contested topology/validation behavior

redaction_policy: Record only that a unit test asserts the behavior; never commit the test path, name, or assertion source.

resolution.query_shape: command-behavior lookup in the data-plane handler for the command family under test

redaction_policy: Strip data-plane paths, symbols, and lines; retain only the public-safe observable behavior.

resolution.query_shape: reference lookup in the Redis Inc Enterprise engine source for the documented internal behavior

redaction_policy: Never commit Redis Inc source paths/symbols/lines; map behavior back to a public-safe statement only.

resolution.query_shape: documentation-section lookup for the Azure Managed Redis feature under test

redaction_policy: Record the public doc section reference in eval-runs; the committed fact text stays generic.

resolution.query_shape: documentation-section lookup for the open-source Redis command/behavior under test

redaction_policy: Public docs only; still route the concrete section reference to eval-runs to keep manifests generic.

resolution.query_shape: runtime probe against a provisioned test instance to confirm the observable signal

redaction_policy: Strip endpoints, hostnames, credentials, subscription ids, and effective config; retain only the abstract signal outcome.

resolution.query_shape: cohort-run lookup in the AMR testing harness for the named execution cohort

redaction_policy: Never commit testing repository paths, test names, subscription ids, lease targets, endpoints, or effective config; resolve provider ids and config-key values into eval-runs only.
